attBesluta.text: Easy to build, extra hardware, really good size, arrived 2 days early. Needed my own screwdriver for the cabinet doors but it came with all other tools needed

The product's aesthetic appeal, style, and perceived value were initially well-received. However, upon assembly, it was discovered that certain components were improperly welded, and some parts were missing. Photographic evidence was provided to Vevor to substantiate these claims. Despite this, the initial response was an acknowledgment of the issue, followed by a subsequent notification indicating case closure without any resolution or further communication regarding the product defect.
I had to buy a longer line-set than the one that came with the VEVOR mini-split that I bought. It was cheaper price wise that what I could buy it for at a supply house. It was exactly what I needed.
Really nice package with good solid insulation wrap.

Put this storage shed together one day after delivery. I have to say that the packaging and the manufacturing of this thing was top notch. EVERY piece fit well and every screw hole lined up. Gold star here. I do have concerns over the engineering of this product though. There are 110 screws to assemble this and everyone of those screws does not have a lot of plastic to bite into. If you are really careful not to strip out any of the screws, the screw connections are still kind of suspect for longevity. I am a VEVOR veteran with a lot of product, and I will return in about a year to update my post here for progress for longevity and how well these screws handle a modest snow and wind load for a season.

I love it! Better than others I saw in person at the store during early spring that were way more expensive. It gives my door a classic elegance and is a nice touch that I can keep (from early spring to the end of summer) so I don't have to change it until early fall. Good size and vibrant colors that haven't faded. It's holding pretty good and didn't lose any leaves or flowers. I'm saving it for next year too. Good quality for the money for sure. Unless you want to change your decoration every year, this can be used for years if you take a good care of it while putting it away.
